symptoms.symptom: PerfecTemp Plus wash temperature is incorrect

causes.label: The washer is in a cold rinse cycle
remedies: This is normal.
The PerfecTemp Plus feature is designed not to activate during a cold rinse cycle to improve the energy efficiency of your washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "The washer is in a cold rinse cycle"

causes.label: Incorrect spin speed selected
remedies: Make sure the spin cycle selected matches the load you are washing.
Some fabrics will feel wetter when rinsed with cold water.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Incorrect spin speed selected"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
Pretreat stain and rewash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Not enough detergent
remedies: Use more detergent (especially with larger loads).
Be sure to follow detergent manufacturer’s directions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Not enough detergent"

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Hard water"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F–140°F (48°C–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Select load size to match clothes load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Detergent is not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent as wash basket fills with water before you load clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Detergent is not dissolving"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Clothes are air or line dried
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Clothes are air or line dried"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time than larger loads.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Detergent not dissolving
remedies: Add detergent as wash basket fills with water, before you load clothes.
Try a liquid detergent.
Use warmer water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Detergent not dissolving"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer basket.
Make sure load size selected matches clothes load size.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Wash speed is too fast
remedies: Choose a wash cycle with a slower wash speed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Wash speed is too fast"

causes.label: The ULTRA HANDWASH, DELICATES or CASUALS cycle was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
The washer alternates between agitate and soak during the ULTRA HANDWASH, DELICATES and CASUALS cycles to get your clothes cleaner with less wear.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "The ULTRA HANDWASH, DELICATES or CASUALS cycle was chosen"

causes.label: The highest SOIL LEVEL setting was chosen
remedies: The highest SOIL LEVEL setting adds a 15 minute Stain Wash agitate and soak period at the beginning of the wash cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "The highest SOIL LEVEL setting was chosen"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: The washer may pause during the spin cycle to remove soapy water more efficiently.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "This is normal"

causes.label: Control panel is asleep
remedies: This is normal.
Press POWER to activate the control panel.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Control panel is asleep"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Check controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up.
remedies: Close lid and reset cycle, to the beginning if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Lid is open—safety feature prevents agitation and spinning when lid is up."

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Electronics need to be reset
remedies: Unplug washer, wait 2 minutes, plug back in and press POWER.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 14: "Electronics need to be reset"

causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to a lower sudsing detergent brand and follow instructions on package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Very soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Very soft water"

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Too much detergent"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and at washer.
Make sure end of drain hose is properly connected to washer and correctly inserted in and secured to drain facility.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they should be replaced every 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency
remedies: New laundry detergents have been formulated to work with cooler water temperatures without affecting wash performance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Cooler water temperatures provide improved energy efficiency"

causes.label: Control is not set properly
remedies: Check water temperature control and adjust.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Control is not set properly"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and disconnect water fill hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: House water heater is not set properly
remedies: Make sure house water heater is delivering water at 120°F–140°F (48°C–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "House water heater is not set properly"

causes.label: PerfecTemp Plus feature was not activated
remedies: The lid must be closed for PerfecTemp Plus to work.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "PerfecTemp Plus feature was not activated"

causes.label: Wash temperature was set to TAP COLD
remedies: When the Tap Cold feature is selected, the water temperature may vary depending on the temperature of your household tap water.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 15: "Wash temperature was set to TAP COLD"

causes.label: Washer is uneven
remedies: To level the front of the washer, adjust the front leveling legs by rotating the individual leg in the proper direction for up or down.
To level back of washer, lift back of machine 4″ (11 cm) and set down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Washer is uneven"

causes.label: Washer load is unbalanced
remedies: Press START to pause the washer, open the lid and redistribute the load evenly.
Close the lid and press START again.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Washer load is unbalanced"

causes.label: Shipping rod is still assembled in unit
remedies: To remove shipping rod from washer, pull yellow tag and attached rod from the bottom right hand side of washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Shipping rod is still assembled in unit"

causes.label: Washer is sitting too close to wall (causes knocking during cycle)
remedies: Pull washer away from the wall; about 4″ (11 cm) is needed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "Washer is sitting too close to wall (causes knocking during cycle)"

causes.label: PerfecTemp Plus feature is being used
remedies: This is normal.
PerfecTemp Plus turns water valves off and on to adjust water temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 16: "PerfecTemp Plus feature is being used"
